rows: Major animal body plans (phyla); first hard skeletons; bilaterian diversification
Great Ordovician Biodiversification Event: marine diversity tripled 485–445 Ma
Placoderms (armored jawed fish like Dunkleosteus) — all extinct at D-C boundary
Dead wood accumulated before lignin-degrading fungi evolved (~300 Ma)
High atmospheric O₂ (~35%); oxygen delivery by diffusion scales with body size
Mammal-lineage tetrapods; distinguished by single temporal fenestra; include pelycosaurs, therapsids, and mammals
Carnivorous synapsid pelycosaur (NOT a dinosaur — Permian, 40 Myr before first dinosaur)
Siberian Traps flood volcanism → CO₂ release → ocean acidification + anoxia + warming
